# Peel

> Remove image backgrounds in the browser. Transparent PNG or a white backdrop. No upload.

The public origin is https://bg-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Remove background](https://bg-local.vercel.app) — u2netp in this tab.

## Guides

* [Transparent PNG](https://bg-local.vercel.app/transparent-png) — Alpha, not a checkerboard JPEG.
* [White background](https://bg-local.vercel.app/white-background) — Marketplace white.
* [Backdrop](https://bg-local.vercel.app/backdrop) — Solid fill after the cut.
* [How to](https://bg-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, cut, download.
* [Product photos](https://bg-local.vercel.app/product-photos) — Edges on bottles and boxes.
* [Portraits](https://bg-local.vercel.app/portraits) — Hair is the hard case.
* [Limits](https://bg-local.vercel.app/limits) — What ONNX will not invent.
* [iPhone](https://bg-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Files vs Photos.
* [WhatsApp](https://bg-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — PNG vs JPEG recode.
* [Marketplace](https://bg-local.vercel.app/marketplace) — White vs transparent.
* [FAQ](https://bg-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy.
